sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐秘。

sentences.en: Our story this week is about a park.
sentences.zh: 我们这周的故事关于一个公园。

sentences.en: Not some massive city park designed by Frederick Law Olmstead or anything,
sentences.zh: 不是那种由弗雷德里克·劳·奥姆斯特德设计的巨大城市公园，
zh_words: 弗雷德里克·劳·奥姆斯特德

sentences.en: just an ordinary neighborhood park in a suburb of St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 而只是圣路易斯郊区的一个普通社区公园。

sentences.en: It's about seven acres with soccer fields, two playgrounds, tennis courts,
sentences.zh: 它大约有七英亩，有足球场、两个游乐场、网球场，

sentences.en: and a creek that runs along the back.
sentences.zh: 还有一条流经后方的小溪。

sentences.en: Dave Davis worked there as a groundskeeper in the 90s.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·戴维斯在90年代在那里做过看护人。

sentences.en: It was an unpaid position, but it came with a strange perk.
sentences.zh: 这是一份没有薪水的工作，但附带了一项奇怪的福利。

sentences.en: The trade-off was that you got to live in a house for free in a good school district,
sentences.zh: 交换条件是，你可以在一个好学区免费住一栋房子，

sentences.en: in a nice neighborhood, a park in your backyard.
sentences.zh: 在一个不错的社区里，后院就是一个公园。

sentences.en: Right at the entrance of the park, there was a house where Dave and his family lived.
sentences.zh: 就在公园入口处，有一栋戴夫和他的家人居住的房子。

sentences.en: At the time, he and his wife were struggling to save enough money to buy their own house,
sentences.zh: 当时，他和妻子正努力攒钱买自己的房子，

sentences.en: so it was perfect for them.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他们来说简直完美。

sentences.en: It quite honestly felt like an answer to a prayer because we were newly married,
sentences.zh: 说实话，这感觉就像是祈祷得到了回应，因为我们刚结婚，

sentences.en: we had two children at this point, and we really wanted to own a home and we wanted to get ahead.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有了两个孩子，我们真的很想拥有一个家，并且想要有所发展。

sentences.en: At first glance, the house seemed like just an ordinary ranch home.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这栋房子看起来就像是一座普通的牧场风格住宅。

sentences.en: From the outside, it looked like pretty much any of the other houses in the area,
sentences.zh: 从外面看，它跟该地区的其他房子几乎一模一样，

sentences.en: But it was when you got inside the house that you realized,
sentences.zh: 但当你走进房子里面时，你才会发现，

sentences.en: wow, and the only way to describe it is to be quick and say,
sentences.zh: 哇，唯一的形容方式就是快点说，

sentences.en: it's like somebody hurried up and finished it.
sentences.zh: 它就像是有人赶工把它盖完的一样。

sentences.en: And that's because that is exactly what had happened.
sentences.zh: 那是因为事实确实如此。

sentences.en: It turns out that Dave's house wasn't supposed to be the home for the groundskeeper.
sentences.zh: 原来戴夫的房子本来不是给公园看护人准备的。

sentences.en: In fact, the park was never supposed to be a park.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这个公园根本就没打算成为公园。

sentences.en: It was private property that once belonged to a prominent black doctor.
sentences.zh: 这是一块曾经属于一位杰出黑人医生的私有土地。

sentences.en: But the land was taken from him before he could even finish building his home.
sentences.zh: 但甚至在他建完房子之前，这块土地就被夺走了。

sentences.en: I grew up near this park.
sentences.zh: 我是在这个公园附近长大的。

sentences.en: I used to walk there after elementary school pretty much every day.
sentences.zh: 我小学放学后几乎每天都去那里散步。

sentences.en: It's in the town of Crevecourt.
It's a French name, Crevecourt, but we pronounce it Crevecourt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个法文名字，Crevecourt，但我们读作Crevecourt。

sentences.en: Today, Crevecourt is mostly white, about 75%.
sentences.zh: 如今，克雷沃克尔的人口主要是白人，大约占75%。

sentences.en: And St. Louis, more broadly, is one of the most segregated cities in the United States.
sentences.zh: 从更广泛的意义上讲，圣路易斯是美国种族隔离最严重的城市之一。

sentences.en: In the past, places like Crevecourt actively prevented non-white people from moving in.
sentences.zh: 过去，像克雷沃克尔这样的地方积极阻止非白人搬进来。

sentences.en: This is the story of one of those people.
sentences.zh: 这就是其中一个人的故事。

sentences.en: That prominent black doctor who, back in the 1950s, wanted his own piece of the suburban dream.
sentences.zh: 那位杰出的黑人医生，早在20世纪50年代，就渴望拥有自己的郊区梦想。

sentences.en: It's about the lengths the town went to to keep him from moving there,
sentences.zh: 这个故事讲述了小镇为了阻止他搬来而采取的极端手段，

sentences.en: and a powerful legal tool that was used to uphold segregation.
sentences.zh: 以及用来维护种族隔离的强大法律工具。

sentences.en: I didn't learn about this history growing up.
sentences.zh: 我在成长过程中并没有学到这段历史。

sentences.en: In a white family, I should say.
sentences.zh: 应该说，是在一个白人家庭里。

sentences.en: The people of Crevecourt ignored it for decades, let it lie buried beneath the green grass of that neighborhood park.
sentences.zh: 克雷沃克尔的人们对此忽视了几十年，任由它埋没在那个社区公园的绿草之下。

sentences.en: But in recent years, the story has resurfaced, forcing my hometown to finally face its ugly paSt.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，这个故事浮出水面，迫使我的家乡终于面对其丑陋的过去。

sentences.en: Howard Philip Venable was a renowned ophthalmologist from Detroit.
sentences.zh: 霍华德·菲利普·维纳布尔是底特律著名的眼科医生。
zh_words: 霍华德·菲利普·维纳布尔

sentences.en: He graduated from medical school with honors in 1940,
sentences.zh: 他在1940年以优异成绩从医学院毕业，

sentences.en: and became the first African American to earn an ophthalmology degree from New York University three years later.
sentences.zh: 三年后成为第一位获得纽约大学眼科学位的非裔美国人。

sentences.en: He passed the board exam with the highest score since its inception.
sentences.zh: 他通过了该考试自创立以来的最高分执照考试。

sentences.en: I always knew him as a larger-than-life character.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得他是一个极具传奇色彩的人物。

sentences.en: That is Rosalind Venable Woodhouse, Dr. Venable's niece.
sentences.zh: 那是罗莎琳德·维纳布尔·伍德豪斯，维纳布尔医生的侄女。
zh_words: 罗莎琳德·维纳布尔·伍德豪斯

sentences.en: Rosalind was close with her uncle growing up.
sentences.zh: 罗莎琳德在成长过程中和她叔叔很亲近。

sentences.en: And she remembers going to the movies to watch her uncle in news clips that they'd play on the big screen.
sentences.zh: 她记得去电影院看大银幕上播放的她叔叔的新闻片段。

sentences.en: That is what used to play between double features at the movies.
sentences.zh: 那是以前在电影院的双片连映之间播放的节目。

sentences.en: And he would be featured because of his accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 而他因自己的成就而成为焦点。

sentences.en: Venable moved to St. Louis in 1943, during the era of Jim Crow.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔于1943年吉姆·克劳法盛行时期搬到圣路易斯。

sentences.en: He worked as an eye doctor at the all-Black Homer G.

sentences.zh: 菲利普斯医院担任眼科医生，

sentences.en: which had a reputation for training some of the best nurses and doctors in the country.
sentences.zh: 该医院以培养全国最优秀的护士和医生而闻名。
维纳布尔也在那里教学。

sentences.en: He had this shtick where he would start his classes by asking students to spell ophthalmology.
sentences.zh: 他有一个习惯，每次上课前都会要求学生拼写“眼科学”。

sentences.en: Glaucoma and cataracts were a big problem in African American communities.
sentences.zh: 青光眼和白内障是非裔美国人社区的一个大问题。

sentences.en: So Venable wanted to prepare his residents to work with Black patients specifically.
sentences.zh: 因此，维纳布尔希望为他的住院医师做好准备，以便专门为黑人患者服务。

sentences.en: One paper that he published on glaucoma in 1952 is still a crucial reference for ophthalmologists today.
sentences.zh: 他在1952年发表的一篇关于青光眼的论文至今仍是眼科医生的重要参考资料。

sentences.en: Venable was also a Renaissance man.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔也是一个多才多艺的人。

sentences.en: Outside of work, he was a talented trumpet player.
sentences.zh: 工作之余，他是一位才华横溢的小号手。

sentences.en: He even played with legends like Ethel Waters and Duke Ellington.
sentences.zh: 他甚至与埃塞尔·沃特斯和杜克·埃灵顿等传奇人物一起演奏过。

sentences.en: And music was a big part of the Venable family life.
sentences.zh: 音乐是维纳布尔家族生活的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: When Dr. Venable and his brothers got together, they used to do this dance called the sand.
sentences.zh: 当维纳布尔医生和他的兄弟们聚在一起时，他们常常跳一种叫“沙舞”的舞蹈。

sentences.en: You would spread sand out, literally like beach sand, on a hardwood floor.
sentences.zh: 你会在硬木地板上撒沙子，字面意思就像海滩上的沙子那样。

sentences.en: And the sound of the feet going over the sand was rhythmic.
sentences.zh: 脚步踏过沙子的声音很有节奏感。

sentences.en: He's always been a kind of dapper dresser.
sentences.zh: 他一直是个很时髦的穿着打扮者。
而且他说话总是很有口才。

sentences.en: You know, and he had like a little funny laugh that he would put on, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他有一种滑稽的笑声，你知道的。

sentences.en: And he was just a remarkable man, you know.
sentences.zh: 他真是一个卓越的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: That's Alan Venable, Dr. Venable's nephew.
sentences.zh: 那是艾伦·维纳布尔，维纳布尔医生的侄子。

sentences.en: Alan remembers his uncle as the life of the party.
sentences.zh: 艾伦记得他叔叔是聚会上的灵魂人物。

sentences.en: He loved to talk, number one.
He just had a presence about himself.
sentences.zh: 他自带一种强大的气场。

sentences.en: Because he knew what he was talking about, and he could take over the room.
sentences.zh: 因为他言之有物，能够掌控全场。

sentences.en: In the 1950s, Venable was a St. Louis socialite.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪50年代，维纳布尔是圣路易斯的社交名流。

sentences.en: He spent time in elite circles with wealthy black and white people.
sentences.zh: 他与富有黑人和白人的精英阶层来往。

sentences.en: And he was used to being the first black person to step foot in places that had previously been for white people only.
sentences.zh: 他习惯了成为第一个踏入以前只有白人才能进入的地方的黑人。

sentences.en: And in 1956, he took one of those steps into the St. Louis suburb of Crevecore.
sentences.zh: 1956年，他迈出了进入圣路易斯郊区克雷沃克尔的一步。

sentences.en: One day in March of 1956, Dr. Venable saw a small ad in a local newspaper promoting 22 vacant lots in Crevecore.
sentences.zh: 1956年3的一天，维纳布尔医生在当地一份报纸上看到一则小广告，推销克雷沃克尔的22块空地。

sentences.en: At the time, Crevecore was an all-white community, sparsely populated with plenty of open space.
sentences.zh: 当时，克雷沃克尔是一个纯白人社区，人口稀少，拥有大量开阔空间。

sentences.en: Venable purchased two of the lots.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔购买了其中两块地。

sentences.en: He paid up front in cash.
My point was, going back to what we said, I wanted freedom of choice.
sentences.zh: 我的观点是，回到我们之前所说的，我想要选择的自由。

sentences.en: I wanted to be able to move anywhere that I had money I felt I couldn't move to.
sentences.zh: 我希望能够搬到任何我有钱却觉得无法搬进去的地方。

sentences.en: That is Dr. Howard Philip Venable himself, speaking on an oral history tape recorded in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这是霍华德·菲利普·维纳布尔医生本人在20世纪80年代录制的口述历史磁带上的讲话。
zh_words: 霍华德·菲利普·维纳布尔

sentences.en: Just like a white doctor with comparable financial status could move anywhere he wanted.
sentences.zh: 就像财务状况相当的白人医生可以搬到他想去的任何地方一样。

sentences.en: And Venable wanted to move to Crevecore to build his dream home.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔想搬到克雷沃克尔建造他的梦想家园。

sentences.en: Everybody was excited because it was ranch style.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很兴奋，因为它是牧场风格的。

sentences.en: And that was the first time I had ever heard of a ranch style home.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次听说牧场风格的住宅。

sentences.en: So that was kind of exotic in my little mind.
sentences.zh: 所以在我幼小的心灵里，这觉得挺新奇的。

sentences.en: Venable's niece Rosalind was a teenager at the time.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔的侄女罗莎琳德当时是个十几岁的青少年。

sentences.en: She remembers looking over the blueprints of her uncle's grand domestic vision.
sentences.zh: 她记得查看她叔叔宏伟的家庭住宅蓝图。

sentences.en: Oh yes, he was talking about a swimming pool, tennis courts, and a nine-hole golf course.
sentences.zh: 哦是的，他当时在谈论游泳池、网球场和九洞高尔夫球场。

sentences.en: Then, some of Venable's colleagues at the hospital got interested in the area too.
sentences.zh: 然后，维纳布尔在医院的一些同事也对这个地区产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: Soon, several more Black families started making plans to buy lots in Crevecore.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，几个更多的黑人家庭开始计划在克雷沃克尔买地。

sentences.en: But achieving the suburban dream was never going to come easy.
sentences.zh: 但实现郊区梦想从来都不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: Even for a group of accomplished doctors with savings and social capital.
sentences.zh: 即使对于一群拥有积蓄和社交资本的成就卓越的医生来说也是如此。

sentences.en: Right away, some of the white residents in Crevecore started organizing against Venable and the other Black families.
sentences.zh: 克雷沃克尔的一些白人居民立刻开始组织起来反对维纳布尔和其他黑人家庭。

sentences.en: They were afraid that their property values would decline if the neighborhood became mixed race.
sentences.zh: 他们担心如果社区变成混血社区，他们的房产价值会下降。

sentences.en: So, they devised a wholesome-looking plan with a sinister twist to keep their new neighbors out.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们设计了一个看起来冠冕堂皇却暗藏险恶用心计划，把他们的新邻居挡在门外。

sentences.en: They would build a park on the lots.
sentences.zh: 他们要在这些土地上修建一个公园。

sentences.en: And they quickly raised $25,000 amongst themselves to make it happen.
sentences.zh: 他们很快在内部筹集了25,000美元来促成此事。

sentences.en: Dr. Venable says they successfully intimidated many of the other Black families.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔医生说，他们成功地恐吓了许多其他黑人家庭。

sentences.en: All the other people took their money out because they scared them.
sentences.zh: 其他人因为害怕都把钱撤回了。

sentences.en: Said, if you don't get your money out of here, you'll lose everything.
sentences.zh: 说，如果你们不把钱从这里撤走，你们就会失去一切。

sentences.en: I went to them and said, look, that lot is yours.
sentences.zh: 我去找他们说，听着，那块地是你们的。

sentences.en: Even though it's down payment, it's like a car.
sentences.zh: 尽管只是首付，它就像一辆车。

sentences.en: If you make a down payment on a car, that car is yours.
sentences.zh: 如果你给一辆车付了首付，那辆车就是你的。

sentences.en: Unless you default on the payments, they can't take that away.
sentences.zh: 除非你付不起贷款，否则他们不能把它夺走。

sentences.en: The other families pulled their money out, but Venable decided to stay and fight.
sentences.zh: 其他家庭撤回了资金，但维纳布尔决定留下来抗争。

sentences.en: He had paid cash for his property.
sentences.zh: 他的房产是用现金支付的。

sentences.en: He owned it outright, and he wasn't about to give it up.
sentences.zh: 他完全拥有它，并不打算轻易放弃。

sentences.en: But I was a fighter, and I would criticize Blacks, whites, anybody if I thought I was right.
sentences.zh: 但我是一个斗士，如果我认为自己是对的，我会批评黑人、白人或任何人。

sentences.en: Dr. Venable hired an architect and started building a brick house right there on his land.
sentences.zh: 维纳布尔医生雇了一位建筑师，开始直接在他的土地上建造一栋砖房。

sentences.en: But the white residents kept trying to push him out.
sentences.zh: 但白人居民不断试图把他赶出去。

sentences.en: If they tried to buy us out about $10,000, we wouldn't sell.
sentences.zh: 如果他们试图出价约10,000美元买断我们，我们是不会卖的。

sentences.en: Then they slapped on this eminent domain.
sentences.zh: 然后他们强加了这项征收权。
政府夺取私人财产的方式。

sentences.en: The rule with eminent domain is that the government can only seize private land if it's for public use,
sentences.zh: 征收权的规则是，政府只有在为了公共利益的情况下才能征收私人土地，

sentences.en: for things that benefit the public, like roads and airports and parks.
sentences.zh: 为了造福公众的事情，比如道路、机场和公园。

sentences.en: But throughout the 20th century, cities across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但在整个20世纪，全美各地的城市

sentences.en: used eminent domain as a tool
sentences.zh: 都将征收权作为一种工具

sentences.en: to take land away from Black people and keep neighborhoods segregated.
sentences.zh: 来剥夺黑人的土地并保持社区的隔离。

sentences.en: Central Park in New York City was a Black neighborhood that got converted to a park using eminent domain.
sentences.zh: 纽约市的中央公园曾经是一个黑人社区，后来通过征收权改建成了公园。

sentences.en: Bruce's Beach, a resort run by a Black couple in Los Angeles in the 1920s, suffered the same fate.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯海滩是20世纪20年代由一对黑人夫妇在洛杉矶经营的度假村，也遭遇了同样的命运。

sentences.en: In fact, Dr. Venable's first house in St. Louis was taken by the state to make a highway.
sentences.zh: 事实上，维纳布尔医生在圣路易斯的的第一栋房子就被州政府征收用来修建高速公路。

sentences.en: One study by the Institute for Justice found that in the 1950s and 60s,
sentences.zh: 正义研究所的一项研究发现，在20世纪50和60年代，

sentences.en: one million people in the U.S.
More than two-thirds of those people were African-American.
sentences.zh: 其中三分之二以上的人是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: And that is exactly what was happening in Kreef Corps.
sentences.zh: 这正是克雷沃克尔正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Many white people supported an effort to use eminent domain to take Venable's land,
sentences.zh: 许多白人支持利用征收权夺取维纳布尔的土地，

sentences.en: where he was actively building his house, and turn it into a park.
sentences.zh: 当时他正在那里积极建造他的房子，并把它变成一个公园。

sentences.en: They called it Byrne Park, after the mayor at the time, John T.
sentences.zh: 他们以当时的市长约翰·T·
伯恩的名字将其命名为伯恩公园，

sentences.en: who was leading the eminent domain effort against Venable.
sentences.zh: 究竟是谁在主导针对维纳尔的征地行动。

sentences.en: And Venable wasn't the only one that Kreef Corps was keeping out.
sentences.zh: 而维纳尔并不是克里夫科尔市排挤的唯一对象。

sentences.en: It turns out the town was also trying to change its zoning code to prevent a Jewish temple,
sentences.zh: 原来，该镇还试图修改分区法，以阻止一座名为“以色列圣殿”的犹太教堂

sentences.en: called Temple Israel, from being built just down the road from the park.
sentences.zh: 在距离公园不远的路边建造。

sentences.en: The Jewish people were in the same club.
sentences.zh: 犹太人有着同样的遭遇。

sentences.en: They were having problems with the same people.
sentences.zh: 他们在和同一拨人打交道时遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: For three long years, Dr. Venable and the Temple fought for their land in court.
